newsitem.title: USA: Florida's citrus in good to excellent shape - FASS.
newsitem.headline: Florida's citrus in good to excellent shape - FASS.

text.p: Most of Florida's well-tended citrus groves were in "very good to excellent condition" in the week ending August 3, according to the Florida Agricultural Statistics Service (FASS).
In its weekly Weather & Crop News report, FASS reported adequate to surplus moisture in all areas of the belt, with summer thunderstorms refilling ponds, lakes and streams.
An abundance of new growth was noted on most trees and new crop fruit continued to make good progress, FASS said.

Caretakers in the region are mowing, chopping and discing cover crops, which have grown with the help of the summer rains. Spot sprays and a few fertilizations have been applied between showers, according to FASS, and pushing, burning and resetting continued in most large groves.
